description: Dedup calibration pairs for local embedding models, written for Nachos (M3 Task 11). Each pair is two third-person conclusions of the kind the Deriver stores. 'paraphrase' pairs state the same fact and should merge; 'distinct' pairs are near misses (same subject and topic, a different fact) and must not. See research/local-embeddings-calibration.md.
